value.synopsis: The Kurosakas report back to Sensei, the founder of the Academy, following their defeat by the Tairas, and are given one last chance to pursue them. Uzu, a new recruit from Class A, is sent to assist. Uzu seems obsessed with Nagi and goes on a rampage under the guise of carrying out his mission, leaving the Kurosakas bewildered by his overwhelming power and erratic behavior.

As the Academy closes in, Shizuka realizes that Sensei's killing intent will fully awaken Nagi. Shizuka and Nagi head to Dr. Radio, designer of the Tank Chair, to complete the No Mark, their means of fighting Sensei. Riding Mark Six: "Mach Speed," they race through a trap-ridden route to the laboratory and attempt to break through by force.
